title: Set a Study Routine
description: Dedicate at least 30-45 minutes daily to consistent learning. Small, daily steps lead to massive career achievements over time.

title: Build Real Projects
description: Don't just watch tutorial videos. Code along with the instructor, make mistakes, and build small dynamic applications to solidify your base.

title: Engage with Community
description: Join student forums, share your code blockages, and collaborate with peer learners. Solving real-world issues together accelerates growth.
